description: Main split: person names, places and street addresses (US, UK, CA, AU, DE, FR) in English text, with look-alikes that must not be flagged.
source: Generated by packages/guard-sdk/src/entity-corpus-generator.ts (seed 20261117). Given names: subset of the US SSA baby-name lists; surnames: subset of the US Census Bureau 2010 surname list (both US government works, public domain). US places: US Census gazetteer names (public domain); other places: names of major cities, regions and countries as plain geographic facts. Streets, numbers and postcodes are invented (postcodes are format-valid only). Templates are hand-written.
